主要内容: In the first three months of 2014, four of Honda's five top-selling models—Accord, Civic, CR-V, and Odyssey—led their segments in retail registrations, according to Honda's analysis of IHS Automotive data. The Accord maintained a narrow lead with 78,355 retail registrations through March, surpassing its nearest competitor by less than 1,000 units. Civic registrations totaled 70,677 units, outperforming competitors by over 10,000 units. CR-V registrations rose 3.9% to 67,773 units, securing a more than 7,000-unit lead over the second-place vehicle. Odyssey registrations reached 27,748 units, making it the top choice among retail minivan customers. Honda's performance in the first quarter of 2014 highlights its strong market position in the U.S. automotive industry.
